According to the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[mythology]], '''Trinta''' was the realm of [[Demon/Legends|demons]]. The Ithorians named the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Trinta]] after this realm because they disliked the planet.<ref name="DoE">''[[Domain of Evil]]''</ref>
